elements.element: Non-solicit obligation is mutual (binds both parties symmetrically)
elements.evidence: First sentence retained one-way: "Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services." while second sentence adds "Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party..." — Customer remains subject to an additional, broader unilateral covenant.

elements.element: Restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services
elements.evidence: Retained sentence 1 covers "any Vendor personnel" with no direct-involvement limitation; only sentence 2 says "personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services".

elements.element: Duration of 12 months from the end of that personnel's involvement
elements.evidence: "for 12 months from the end of that involvement"; sentence 1 also "for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services".

elements.element: Carve-out for general advertisements not specifically targeted
elements.evidence: "this Section does not restrict general advertisements not specifically targeted at the other party's employees"

elements.element: Carve-out for unsolicited approaches by an employee

elements.evidence: "hire, or employ" deleted; both sentences restrict only "solicit".

elements.element: No non-solicit binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel" remains operative.

offending_extra_words: Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services.
reasons: The edit left the original Customer-only covenant in place and stacked a mutual covenant on top of it, so Customer bears a duplicated and broader restriction (all "Vendor personnel", plus a term-long prohibition) while Vendor is bound only as to personnel "directly involved in the Services". That fails the fallback's mutuality and direct-involvement scope limits.

Sentence 1 also reads oddly as drafted: it applies to "any Vendor personnel" yet measures the tail from "the end of their involvement in the Services", leaving a dangling mechanic for personnel who were never involved in the Services.

Minimality fails: the correct minimal fix was to convert the existing sentence to a mutual, directly-involved, 12-month covenant and append the two carve-outs, not to retain the one-sided sentence and add a second overlapping covenant creating duplicated protection.

Suggested fix: replace paragraph 12.4 in full with the mutual sentence only — "Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of that involvement; this Section does not restrict general advertisements not specifically targeted at the other party's employees or unsolicited approaches by an employee."
